## About
Wendell Solesbee was repairing and customizing his own cars back in high school. Later, while working as an electronic engineer on projects like the Apollo moon rocket, he kept fixing cars on the side. Martha, his wife, sanded primer and prepped cars at home while he was at work, and he would come home at lunch to prime or paint. Eventually they decided to leave engineering behind and make custom work and collision repair a full-time career.
Today the shop is run by the Solesbee brothers, and Wendell and Martha are still actively involved. The office is full of family too: nieces, nephews, and in-laws. Our goal is simple, every customer a family member, and yes, we still hand out the famous Solesbee tee shirt with every repair.
Customers rate us 4.5 from 129 Google reviews. Stop by 2nd Street in Yorba Linda any weekday.

## Services
- Collision repair: All types of collision repair, from the little door ding to the major collision.
- Wheel alignments: When a repair involves an impacted wheel or frame damage, we handle the alignment here on our own laser sighted alignment machine.
- Paint matching: We match any type, brand, or kind of paint, then cure it in our heated spray booths.
- Custom paint and restoration: Our restoration division at the same location does everything from custom paint and design to full auto restoration. Appointments are necessary.

## FAQ
Q: Do I have to use a shop on my insurance company's list?
A: No. You can take your car to any auto repair shop, and the insurance company is required to pay a fair and competitive price.

Q: How do I set up custom paint or restoration work?
A: Appointments are necessary for custom and restoration work. Give us a call and ask for Greg Solesbee.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
